verdict.rationale: Superset documents task management and lets you script task creation and triage through its SDK, CLI and MCP server. None of the evidence shows a feature that ingests user feedback submissions and turns them into structured tasks with proposed scope. The nearest items do not qualify: turning comments on shared designs into updates, sending PR diff feedback to an agent, and SDK primitives for bulk task creation are adjacent features or developer building blocks.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope
